Young Peruvian children and their caregivers link migration with the process through which they can ‘become somebody’.

(1) migration is a key component of the process of becoming somebody, as a way of achieving social and economic mobility; (2) young people’s aspirations to migrate and their educational aspirations are interrelated and are shaped by the same factors: (3) the process of becoming someone is gendered and is shaped by the social and cultural context in which young people live and the social and economic capital that they have available.
